learning_outcomes.text: Defines basic quality concepts, quality development, dimensions, and elements.
Explains quality gurus and their contributions to quality and discusses their teachings.
Explains Total Quality Management and its principles.
Explains the concept of Continuous Improvement (KAIZEN) and KAIZEN Techniques.
Defines the concept of Process Management.
Interprets the necessity of standard and standardization.
Recognizes Quality Management Systems and explains standard requirements.
Explains the EFQM Model and defines its criteria.

syllabus_topics: Elements of Quality, Quality Management and Quality Gurus
Principles of Total Quality Management (Customer Focus, Leadership, Participation, Process Approach)
Principles of Total Quality Management (System Approach, KAIZEN, Utilizing Scientific Methods in Decision Making, Collaboration with Suppliers)
Continuous Improvement (KAIZEN) and Techniques (Basic concepts, KAIZEN Success Factors, Quality Circles)
Continuous Improvement (KAIZEN) and Techniques (Simple Continuous Improvement Tools, Seven Tools)
ISO 9001 Quality Management System Requirements and Certification Stages
assessment_rules: The midterm exam accounts for 40% of the grade, and the final exam accounts for 60%. Midterm and final exam dates are determined by the University Senate based on the academic calendar.
